messages.content: What is the change in entropy in Joules per Kelvin of a 1kg ice block at 0°C if it is heated to 100°C under 1 atmosphere of pressure?

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.content:
**Answer:**  
The total change in entropy for heating a 1 kg ice block from 0 °C to 100 °C at 1 atm is approximately **8.6 × 10³ J K⁻¹** (≈ 8 580 J K⁻¹).

**Why this value?**  
The process involves three reversible steps:

| Step | Process | ΔS (J K⁻¹) |
|------|---------|------------|
| 1 | Melting ice at 0 °C (273.15 K) | \( \Delta S_{\text{melt}} = \frac{m\,L_f}{T} = \frac{1\,\text{kg}\times 334\,000\,\text{J kg}^{-1}}{273.15\,\text{K}} \approx 1\,222\,\text{J K}^{-1}\) |
| 2 | Heating liquid water from 0 °C to 100 °C | \( \Delta S_{\text{heat}} = m\,c_{\text{water}}\ln\!\left(\frac{T_2}{T_1}\right) = 1\,\text{kg}\times 4\,184\,\text{J kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}\ln\!\left(\frac{373.15}{273.15}\right) \approx 1\,306\,\text{J K}^{-1}\) |
| 3 | Vaporizing water at 100 °C (373.15 K) | \( \Delta S_{\text{boil}} = \frac{m\,L_v}{T} = \frac{1\,\text{kg}\times 2\,257\,000\,\text{J kg}^{-1}}{373.15\,\text{K}} \approx 6\,051\,\text{J K}^{-1}\) |

Adding them gives:
\( \Delta S_{\text{total}} \approx 1\,222 + 1\,306 + 6\,051 \approx 8\,579\,\text{J K}^{-1}\).

Rounded to the nearest whole number, the change in entropy is **8 580 J K⁻¹**.
